videos.caption: Here is my completed coloring book flip through of Cozy Corner by Coco Wyo! It was kind of hard to find a song to flip the pages to and still don’t know if I was completely successful 😅Also I want to say that this was my first Coco Wyo book/coloring book of this style and the first time I used alcohol markers. That being said, some of the pages I colored are from my brain but a lot of them are copied from Pinterest, Insta, or TikTok because I was afraid I would mess up the page and wanted to learn some of the techniques by doing them like someone else. I have ventured out a now and trying to do more on my own or try to just use pieces of inspiration. Thank you to the creators that posted theirs so I could learn something from it. Hope you enjoy the flip through.  #cocowyo #coloringbook #cozycorner #alcoholmarkers #creatorsearchinsights
